statement: Amateur athletes doing home cold-water immersion cannot hold target temperature without a chiller and improvise insulation and ice routines.
mechanism: passive heat gain in an uninsulated tub outpaces ice addition in warm months
population: amateur athletes practising post-training cold immersion at home
task: keep water at target temperature for the session
context: outdoor or garage tub, summer, no powered chiller
assumptions: most practitioners lack a powered chiller

contradictions.statement: one community reports plunging only in winter, when drift is not a problem

falsifiers: temperature drift is not mentioned as recurring across three independent communities
